def rdm_to_dvec(rdm):
    """
    Convert density matrix to density vector.
    """
    return np.array(rdm).flatten()

def vqft(qregs, wires):
    """
    Apply variational quantum Fourier transform (VQFT) on the given qregs and wires.
    """
    def apply_VQFT(var):
        for i in range(len(qregs)):
            for j in range(len(wires)):
                # Apply a Hadamard gate to the j-th qubit in the i-th register
                qml.Hadamard(qregs[i][j])
                # Apply a controlled rotation gate to the j-th qubit
                qml.CCNOT(wires=[qregs[i], wires[j]])
                # Apply a rotation gate to the target qubit
                var.append(qml.RX(var.shape[0] / 2, wires=wires[j]))
        return var

    return apply_VQFT(qregs, wires)
